retention.path_policy: agentmesh app run writes host sidecars under --sidecar-dir/YYYY-MM-DD/<run-id>/full.json; this compact payload retains only transcript digests, not raw transcripts

serialization.array_order: contract-defined; diagnostics sorted by code/field/severity/message; adapter capabilities preserve supplied order
serialization.null_policy: missing optional scalar fields serialize as null; malformed inputs retain a deterministic envelope
